### Task 1: Design plan

**Topology.** I chose a two-stage Miller-compensated op-amp with an NMOS input pair and a nulling resistor. This design has not been simulated. All numbers below are hand estimates and need to be confirmed across the 45 PVT corners in ngspice.

**Why this topology:**
- The required gain is 59 dB, and PSRR needs 73 dB. A 5T OTA or a folded cascode would be marginal on gain within the power budget. A two-stage op-amp with long-L devices is estimated at about 80–85 dB.
- An NMOS input pair suits VCM ≈ 0.9 V, because the pfet |Vth| is about 1 V and leaves little headroom for a PMOS pair.
- The power limit at 1.98 V is 110 uW, which allows about 55 uA total. The design draws 10 (reference) + 10 (tail) + 20 (stage 2) = 40 uA, or about 79 uW at 1.98 V.

**Devices and connections:**

| Device | Connection (d g s b) | Role |
|---|---|---|
| MB0 nfet 10/1 | ibias ibias vss vss | Diode that sinks the 10 uA reference and creates the NMOS bias voltage on node `ibias` |
| M5 nfet 10/1 | tail ibias vss vss | Tail current source, 10 uA (1:1 mirror). Wide, so Vdsat ≈ 0.1 V for headroom at ss/−40 C/1.62 V |
| M1 nfet 40/2 | n1 vinn tail vss | Input transistor, inverting side (drives the diode side of the mirror) |
| M2 nfet 40/2 | n2 vinp tail vss | Input transistor, non-inverting side (drives the stage-1 output node n2) |
| M3 pfet 10/2 | n1 n1 vdd vdd | Diode-connected PMOS mirror load |
| M4 pfet 10/2 | n2 n1 vdd vdd | PMOS mirror output; stage-1 output node is n2 |
| M7 pfet 40/2 | vout n2 vdd vdd | Second-stage common-source amplifier, 20 uA |
| M8 nfet 20/1 | vout ibias vss vss | Second-stage current-sink load, 20 uA (1:2 mirror) |
| Rz 6 kΩ | n2 → nz | Nulling resistor (about 1.5/gm7), moves the RHP zero into the LHP |
| Cc 12 pF | nz → vout | Miller compensation capacitor |

**Output polarity.** When vinp rises, M2 draws more current, so n2 falls. M7 then sources more current, so vout rises. This makes vinp the non-inverting input, as required.

**Bias and systematic offset.**
- All NMOS bias currents are mirrored from the ibias diode: tail = 1×, stage 2 = 2×.
- M7 runs at the same current density as M4: 20 uA/40 um equals 5 uA/10 um, both at L = 2. So the stage-1 output sits at the M3 diode voltage, which gives near-zero systematic offset.

**Estimated performance (hand calculations, not simulated):**

| Quantity | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Input pair operating point | Weak inversion, gm1 ≈ 105–185 uS across temperature |
| GBW = gm1/(2π·Cc) | About 1.4 MHz at 27 C; about 1.0 MHz hot, about 2.4 MHz cold (spec ≥ 220 kHz) |
| gm7 | About 240 uS |
| Second pole p2 ≈ gm7/(2π·CL) | About 19 MHz, more than 8× GBW |
| Mirror pole (n1) | About 20 MHz |
| Phase margin (with LHP zero from Rz) | About 70–80° |
| Stage-1 gain (L = 2 devices) | About 100 |
| Stage-2 gain (L = 2 pfet against L = 1 nfet) | About 150–200 |
| Total DC gain | About 80–85 dB, which supports PSRR > 73 dB and CMRR > 60 dB (tail L = 1) |
| Slew rate = Itail/Cc | About 0.8 V/us, versus the 0.1 V/us requirement |
| 1% settling | About 1 us, versus the 3.8 us limit |
| Noise | Input-pair W·L = 80 um² per device keeps 1/f noise to a few tenths of a uV/√Hz at 1 kHz. Long-L PMOS loads with lower gm add only a small contribution. Thermal noise is about 20 nV/√Hz. |
| Output swing | M7 and M8 can approach each rail within about 0.15 V, giving much more than the 0.24 V required |

**Headroom check.** The tail node sits at about VCM − Vgs1 ≈ 0.2–0.35 V. Node n1 sits at about VDD − |Vgs3| ≈ 0.45–0.75 V. So M1/M2 and M5 stay saturated even at ss/1.62 V.

**Verification before relying on this design:**
- Confirm headroom at ss / −40 C / 1.62 V.
- Confirm phase margin at ff / −40 C.
- Confirm the 1 kHz noise against the actual sky130 flicker model.

### Task 2: Netlist

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks the 10 uA reference
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=1
* tail current source (10 uA)
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=10 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinp drives the output-side device -> non-inverting)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=40 L=2
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=40 L=2
* PMOS current-mirror load
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=2
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=2
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink (20 uA)
M7  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=40 L=2
M8  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=20 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n2 nz 6k
Cc  nz vout 12p
.ends
```
